judge.rationale: A common core of PTMA, PABPC1, CKS2, FTH1, ribosomal proteins, tubulins, and glycolytic enzymes supports a shared proliferative-growth explanation, but more than half of the complete molecular content differs through variable inclusion of extensive OXPHOS, histone, cell-cycle, proteostasis, redox, and lineage contributors, invoking the shared-minority ceiling of 4.
